name: pt9-warfare-redistribute-turn-end
description: Playtest 9 pbd539 (086/087): Warfare's 'redistribute command tokens?' offer from round 1 stayed under 'Available now' through rounds 2-4 (Skip only set it aside). Fix (bot pt9-followups, ChooseConfirmKind.obsolete): a redistribute offer posted before the current turn began (Game.lastActivePlayerChange) is closed in the action phase; the web's Skip closes it on the page. Base: sc-warfare-te-activate (pbd28 r1, Mahact holds Thunder's Edge Warfare): the primary posts the offer, every other player declines, Mahact ends the turn without the tactical action; the offer is gone.
